property_summary: For any initial state and any inputs, calling newGrantProposal increments proposalCount by exactly 1 (so newCount == oldCount + 1); the mutant that increments by 2 will violate this for some inputs, causing proposalCount to differ from old+1.
change_summary: Increment proposalCount by 2 instead of 1, so proposalCount increases differently after newGrantProposal.
